conventions.commits: Conventional Commits enforced by commitlint config-conventional (.commitlintrc.yml); CONTRIBUTING.md requires GPG-signed (git commit -S) and DCO sign-off (--signoff). Swift precedent subject: 'feat(core): add Swift language support with tree-sitter-swift handler (#1742)'.
conventions.testing: Inline #[cfg(test)] mod tests in each languages/*.rs with a parse_<lang>(src) helper, StreamingIterator + QueryCursor::matches, and a queries_compile test; integration tests live in crates/aptu-coder/tests/ and use common::call_tool_raw and tempfile NamedTempFile::with_suffix_in.
conventions.linting: cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --locked --profile ci -- -D warnings -W clippy::cognitive_complexity (ci.yml line 137); cargo deny check advisories licenses bans (ci.yml line 211); clippy.toml cognitive-complexity-threshold = 30; workspace lints deny undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used.
conventions.error_handling: Handlers return Option or Vec, never Result; get_node_text returns Option and bounds-checks; registry lookup returns ParserError::UnsupportedLanguage for an unknown name; Java's raw slicing in extract_inheritance is the weaker precedent, Swift's get_node_text is the safer one.

patterns: Registry shape: each language is a module with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY constants plus optional handler fns, wired by one match arm in get_language_info() and one in get_ts_language() (languages/mod.rs).

Extension mapping is a static EXTENSION_MAP slice of (ext, lang) pairs in lang.rs; supported_extensions() feeds the JSON schema pattern through schema_helpers.rs, so no separate schema edit is needed.

Element captures: @function on the declaration node with @func_name or @method_name for the name; @class on the declaration node with @class_name for classes, interfaces, traits and enums (java.rs uses @class for interface and enum).
Def-use captures use prefixes write.*, read.*, writeread.* (parser_elements.rs 878-884); the read pattern is a catch-all identifier pattern, de-duplicated by byte offset against write captures.
Inheritance handlers return Vec<String> with 'extends X' / 'implements X' prefixes (java.rs, swift.rs uses 'extends' and 'conforms').
The css.rs precedent shows a minimal language: ELEMENT_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, empty CALL_QUERY, other fields None, and inline tests with an empty-file case.

The swift commit (dbc2971) touched six files: Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, crates/aptu-coder-core/Cargo.toml, lang.rs, languages/mod.rs and languages/swift.rs. This is the full wiring set for a new grammar.

constraints: The issue states external PRs are not accepted; maintainers implement in-house. This Scout output is research only.

Scope excludes tool handler and schema changes; the MCP tool descriptions and crates/aptu-coder/src/lib.rs line 23 hardcode language lists. Updating those lists is a scope question for the maintainer.

Cargo deny age gate: tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 was published 2026-11-19T16:26:36Z, about 8 days before 2026-11-28, so it clears the 7-day gate without SKIP_PACKAGE_AGE_CHECK. 0.25.1 (2026-10-06) is the fallback.

Use LANGUAGE_PHP, not LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY: the issue needs HTML-mixed files to parse with zero ERROR nodes, and only php/grammar.js (program: optional(text), optional(php_tag, repeat(statement))) accepts leading text.

DEFUSE_QUERY is Option<&'static str> in LanguageInfo, so the compiler does not require it (Fortran sets None). It is required by the issue's acceptance criteria and by analyze_symbol def_use mode; without it parser.rs line 159 yields no def-use sites.

PHP variables are variable_name nodes whose child is name without the $ sigil, so symbol matching in def_use (node_text == symbol_name) needs the bare name 'x' for $x. Whether the maintainer wants $x accepted is an open question.

Lookup chain: analyze_str -> language_for_extension (lang.rs) -> supported_languages() -> QUERY_CACHE (parser.rs) -> get_language_info (mod.rs). php must be present in both lang.rs lists and in mod.rs for analysis to succeed.

Environment note: one gh api call without a trailing slash (repos/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php) was denied by the experiment fence and was not retried; all permitted reads used the trailing-slash form.
Java inheritance uses fields superclass and interfaces; PHP base_clause and class_interface_clause have no fields, so the PHP walk must iterate named children.
test_coverage: Existing languages each have inline #[cfg(test)] tests: java.rs (queries parse, element query on class plus method, extract_inheritance, defuse write site), swift.rs (queries_compile for all five constants, element query, inheritance with and without clauses), css.rs (element and import extraction, empty file). lang.rs tests cover language_for_extension happy and edge cases and the schema pattern covering every EXTENSION_MAP entry. mod.rs test_get_language_info_covers_remaining_registered_languages is table-driven and is the place to add php. Integration tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests/integration_tests.rs use NamedTempFile with .rs suffix and cover fields, unsupported extension, and schema compliance; no integration test exercises css, yaml or swift today.

approaches.name: A: Full mirror of Java/Swift registry (recommended)
approaches.description: New languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (function_definition, method_declaration, class, interface, trait, enum), CALL_QUERY (function_call_expression, member_call_expression, nullsafe_member_call_expression, scoped_call_expression), REFERENCE_QUERY (empty or name-based), IMPORT_QUERY (namespace_use_declaration), DEFUSE_QUERY (variable_name writes and reads) and extract_inheritance walking base_clause and class_interface_clause named children. Use LANGUAGE_PHP. Wire Cargo.toml (root and core), Cargo.lock, lang.rs (EXTENSION_MAP and supported_languages), mod.rs (pub mod, get_language_info, get_ts_language). Add inline unit tests and one integration test file; update README. Call query sketch: (function_call_expression function: (name) @call), (member_call_expression name: (name) @call), (nullsafe_member_call_expression name: (name) @call), (scoped_call_expression name: (name) @call). Import query sketch: (namespace_use_declaration) @import_path, which excludes trait use (use_declaration) as the issue's Not in Scope requires.
pros: Follows the swift.rs and java.rs shape, so reviewers recognise it
LANGUAGE_PHP handles HTML-mixed files with zero ERROR nodes, as the issue requires
DEFUSE_QUERY enables analyze_symbol def_use for PHP
cons: Read-pattern for name nodes must exclude function and class names; variable_name scoping keeps it narrower than Java's identifier catch-all
Binary size grows with the grammar; the issue requires the delta in the PR description

approaches.name: B: Minimal element and inheritance only
approaches.description: Implement php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY and extract_inheritance only; set call_query, import_query and defuse_query to empty or None, as Fortran and Markdown do for some fields. Wire the same registry entries.
pros: Lowest risk of query compile errors beyond ELEMENT_QUERY
Quick to ship the element and inheritance output the issue lists first
cons: Fails acceptance criteria for calls, imports and the five-constant requirement
analyze_symbol call_graph and def_use return nothing for PHP
Integration test and README updates remain required, so the saving is smaller than it looks

approaches.name: C: Dual grammar selected by content sniffing
approaches.description: Register php with LANGUAGE_PHP and a second internal name for pure PHP files that use LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY, choosing per file by checking whether the file starts with '<?php'. Requires a branch in get_ts_language or the parser entry path rather than a single match arm.
pros: Pure PHP files parse without text nodes, which may be slightly cleaner
cons: Two grammars for one extension breaks the single-entry EXTENSION_MAP model
Changes shared parser entry logic outside the issue's stated scope
LANGUAGE_PHP already accepts pure PHP, so the benefit is small
Adds complexity for no acceptance criterion

recommendation: Approach A. It matches the issue's acceptance criteria, mirrors the Java and Swift registry shape, and needs only LANGUAGE_PHP to satisfy the HTML-mixed requirement. Keep the three optional handlers (extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver, find_receiver_type) set to None, as the issue's Not in Scope section asks. Verify each query with Query::new in a unit test before wiring, as the issue's Suggested Approach step 3 says, because the sample query texts in this output were checked against the grammar's node-types.json but not compiled.

inheritance_walk_citation: Entry node: class_declaration. Grammar source: php/grammar.js requires common/define-grammar.js (fetched via gh api, path common/define-grammar.js, lines 365-379): class_declaration: prec.right(seq(optional(field('attributes', $.attribute_list)), repeat($._modifier), keyword('class'), field('name', reserved('classes', $.name)), optional($.base_clause), optional($.class_interface_clause), field('body', $.declaration_list))). Step 1: node.child_by_field_name("name") gives the class name (a `name` node) and is skipped. Step 2: iterate node.named_children(); for each child whose kind() == "base_clause" (grammar lines 334-337: base_clause: seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1($._name))), iterate its named children; each child is one of name | qualified_name | relative_name (node-types.json children of base_clause: ["name", "qualified_name", "relative_name"]); push format!("extends {text}"). Step 3: for each child whose kind() == "class_interface_clause" (grammar lines 381-384: class_interface_clause: seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1($._name))), iterate its named children the same way and push format!("implements {text}"). Field check: node-types.json reports fields {} for both base_clause and class_interface_clause, so there is no field name to use with child_by_field_name; this differs from java.rs, which uses the superclass and interfaces fields. Expected output for `class Foo extends Bar implements A, B`: ["extends Bar", "implements A", "implements B"]. For a class with neither clause, the walk visits no base_clause or class_interface_clause and returns Vec::new(). Related kinds (same grammar source): enum_declaration has optional class_interface_clause (line 344) and no base_clause; interface_declaration has optional base_clause (line 330) and no class_interface_clause; trait_declaration has neither (lines 319-324). Qualified names keep their leading backslash in raw text (qualified_name.prefix is the '\\' token), consistent with java.rs keeping raw text.
